requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-driven productivity features, including Perfect Print and Perfect Scan, as well as AI-based scan workflow and support into the Magellan printer for enhanced business efficiency and ease of management.
requirements.Rationale: AI features are a key differentiator for Magellan, addressing SMB needs for productivity and manageability, especially for customers lacking dedicated IT support.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires software development for AI features; integration with SMB portal and device management systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI-driven Perfect Print and Perfect Scan functionalities are implemented and validated through user testing; AI support features are available in the SMB portal.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO (Total Cost of Ownership)
requirements.Description: Design the Magellan printer to deliver HP’s lowest business TCO for SMB customers, through cost-efficient ink tank technology and minimal intervention requirements.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs prioritize ROI and efficiency; a low TCO is essential to compete with other business printers and attract the target segment.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires cost analysis, supply chain optimization, and efficient ink tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: TCO calculations show Magellan as the lowest in HP’s business portfolio; validated by internal cost modeling and competitive benchmarking.

requirements.Title: First HP Business Ink Tank Printer
requirements.Description: Develop Magellan as HP’s first business-class ink tank printer, targeting the CISS PLE Hi segment to fill the current product portfolio gap.
requirements.Rationale: HP lacks a business-class ink tank offering; this is needed to address new market opportunities and competitive threats.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on successful design, manufacturing, and launch of a new ink tank platform.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan is launched as HP’s first business ink tank printer and is positioned in the CISS PLE Hi segment.

requirements.Title: Consolidated Device Management SMB Portal
requirements.Description: Provide a consolidated online portal for SMBs to manage Magellan printers, including device setup, monitoring, and maintenance tools, optimized for non-IT users (Office Managers/Generalist IT).
requirements.Rationale: Target customers lack dedicated IT staff; a simple, comprehensive portal enhances manageability and customer satisfaction.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires portal software development and integration with printer telemetry and AI solutions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is live and functional, with positive user feedback from target SMB segments; supports all key management features.

requirements.Title: Customer-Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design the maintenance box to be easily replaceable by the customer (PHA), with a service center option (MINK) if out of warranty, to minimize downtime and service costs.
requirements.Rationale: Unmanaged SMBs need minimal intervention and quick resolution for maintenance; customer-replaceable parts reduce support burden and improve satisfaction.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware design for easy replacement; documentation and support for replacement process.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box replacement can be performed by customers within 10 minutes, with clear instructions; validated by usability testing.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles for Refilling
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles to ensure correct refilling, reduce errors, and prevent misuse or counterfeiting of supplies.
requirements.Rationale: Keyed bottles help prevent supply-related issues and protect HP’s supplies business and customer experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires new supply design and manufacturing processes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed bottles are compatible only with Magellan and prevent incorrect installation; tested in supply chain and user scenarios.

requirements.Title: Warranty and Serviceability
requirements.Description: Offer a standard warranty of 80,000 pages or 2 years (whichever is first), with clear serviceability paths (customer replaceable or service center) for key components.
requirements.Rationale: Clear warranty and service terms are important for SMBs making purchasing decisions and for total cost of ownership calculations.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires warranty policy definition and service process setup.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are published and adhered to; serviceability process documented and validated.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL and PDL SKU Differentiation
requirements.Description: Provide both Non-PDL and PDL SKUs, with Non-PDL supporting SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB portal, and PDL SKU supporting improved print speeds (25/20 ppm), PDL/PS support, and Blue Angel certification.
requirements.Rationale: Different SKUs allow HP to address varied SMB needs and regulatory requirements.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, R&D Telemetry, Tech Reg, DVAR
requirements.Dependencies: Requires SKU-specific development and certification processes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Both SKUs are available with listed features; PDL SKU meets Blue Angel requirements and speed targets.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure that the Magellan printer is manufactured with at least 60% recycled content plastic, exceeding competitor levels (Epson 30%, Canon TBC).
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a key differentiator and customer expectation in the SMB market.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires sourcing of recycled materials and manufacturing process adaptation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Manufacturing BOM and third-party audit confirm 60% RCP in production units.

requirements.Title: Minimal Maintenance and Parts Replacement
requirements.Description: Engineer the printer to require minimal maintenance and fewer parts replacements over its operational life, reducing downtime and support needs for SMB customers.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs want maintenance-free or low-maintenance products; reduces cost and increases uptime.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires robust hardware design and validation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Field data shows reduced maintenance and parts replacement compared to previous HP models; validated in pilot deployments.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing and HP App Integration
requirements.Description: Support mobile printing and seamless integration with the HP App, allowing users to print, scan, and manage devices from mobile devices.
requirements.Rationale: Mobile printing is an expected feature for SMBs; enhances convenience and accessibility.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires mobile app development and printer firmware compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing and HP App integration tested and validated on iOS and Android platforms.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Platform as a Service) Support
requirements.Description: Enable Magellan to support Platform as a Service (PaaS) features, allowing integration with future HP services and solutions.
requirements.Rationale: PaaS support enables future scalability, monetization, and integration with HP’s evolving ecosystem.
requirements.Stakeholders: Tech Reg, Marketing, R&D Telemetry, BA
requirements.Dependencies: Requires architecture planning and software development for PaaS integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS features are available and documented; integration tested with HP service offerings.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features to collect printer usage, health, and performance data for remote monitoring, diagnostics, and analytics.
requirements.Rationale: Telemetry enables proactive support, device management, and product improvement through data-driven insights.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires telemetry hardware/software and integration with SMB portal and support systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is collected, securely transmitted, and accessible for analytics; validated in pilot deployments.
